title: Family Gathering Picnic, 1950s Snapshot, Black & White, Rural
back_text_transcription: Dad, Joe, Cary, Vene, Donna, & Del July 25, 1954 560
description: A 1954 candid vintage snapshot depicting an American family enjoying a rural summer picnic outdoors under a large tree near wooden outbuildings. The scene captures post-war mid-century everyday domestic leisure, with family members seated on crates and improvised benches.
